heros.infro: George Washington was the commander of the Continental Army during the War for Independence and the first President of the United States. Due to these factors he is considered the Father of the country.  Considering his lack of resources and men he had to work with, his victories in the war are impressive, especially at Saratoga and Yorktown. AS President he was a supporter of a strong central government and championed against getting involved in foreign wars.
heros.name: George Washington
